interface.description: Network interface name to create for the VPN (e.g., tun0).

gateway.description: IP address or hostname of the VPN gateway.

psk.description: Pre-shared key (PSK) for IPSec authentication. If empty, you will be prompted at runtime.

ike_dh_group.description: IKE Diffie-Hellman group for key exchange. Common: modp1024, modp1536, modp2048.

ike_authmode.description: IKE authentication mode. Only 'psk' is typically used for vpnc.

ike_encryption.description: IKE phase 1 encryption algorithm. Supported: aes, 3des, des.

ike_hash.description: IKE phase 1 hash algorithm. Supported: sha1, md5.

ike_lifetime.description: IKE phase 1 SA lifetime in seconds.

ipsec_hash.description: IPSec (phase 2) hash algorithm. Supported: sha1, md5.

ipsec_pfs.description: Perfect Forward Secrecy (PFS) DH group. Use 'off' to disable.

local_ip.description: Local endpoint IP address. Leave blank for auto.

local_port.description: Local UDP port to use for NAT-T. 0 means auto.

natt_mode.description: Enable Cisco NAT Traversal. Set to 'off' if not behind NAT.

domain.description: DNS suffixes to append to domain names. vpnc treats this as Domain directive (multiple allowed, but template joins as single line).

dns_servers.description: List of DNS server IPs to configure for the VPN. If empty, servers are set by the VPN gateway (if supported).

routes.description: List of subnets to route through the VPN. Each route creates a Subnet directive.

no_nat.description: List of subnets to reach *directly* (not via VPN). Creates No NAT directives.

xauth_username.description: XAuth username for secondary authentication (if required by gateway).

xauth_password.description: XAuth password. If empty, prompt at runtime.

proxy_arp.description: Enable proxy ARP on the VPN interface.
